CustomObject.description: Persisted, queryable catalog novelty feed for the Buyer Group Catalog Pulse feature. Records are created/updated by the Catalog_Pulse_Event__e subscriber and read by the storefront controller (entitlement-aware). The OBJECT is metadata; the RECORDS are runtime data (ADR-0003). Private sharing: buyers reach it only through the without-sharing Apex controller that re-validates entitlements.
CustomObject.label: Catalog Pulse Item
